tokens.name: carbon-black
tokens.usage: Core brand black (#0B0C0E). The ground all marks sit on; page background in the Noir theme. A brand constant — same in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Brand graphite (#202226). Raised panels and the second colour of the palette. A brand constant — same in both themes.

tokens.name: platinum
tokens.usage: Signature platinum (#BFC2C5). The metallic brand accent for marks, rules and emphasis. Place on carbon-black or graphite only — it is low-contrast on light surfaces.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Carbon-black in Noir, a cool off-white in Platinum.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and nav resting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and elevated layers above surface-raised.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and default control borders on surface and surface-raised. 3:1 against both.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasis borders and the resting outline of inputs on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary heading and body text on surface and surface-raised. ≥12:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles and secondary copy on surface and surface-raised. ≥7:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and placeholder text on surface and surface-raised. ≥4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive metallic accent: links, selected state, key emphasis on surface and surface-raised. Platinum in Noir; a graphite-silver in Platinum for contrast.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons sitting on an accent fill (e.g. a platinum button). ≥8:1 on accent in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of accent; the brightest platinum sheen in Noir.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The FALBER name at hero scale. Always uppercase, in platinum on carbon-black.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Campaign headers and section covers. Uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark-serif
styles.usage: The engraved serif wordmark lockup. Uppercase, wide tracking, platinum.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The clean modern FALBER wordmark (thin, widely tracked) as on packaging. Uppercase; never below 0.3em tracking.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy in text on surface.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase UI labels and eyebrows. Wide tracking, in text-muted or platinum.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fine print and metadata in text-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact padding, chip insets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the base rhythm unit.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of grouped blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Major section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters and hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Editorial whitespace between large sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Buttons, inputs, cards and panels — the brand reads sharp and engraved.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle softening on small chips and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Image and media containers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Fully rounded pills and avatars only.

shadow.note: Elevation reads mainly through surface lightness; shadows stay subtle.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Resting elevation of cards on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and modals above the page.
